companions.name: The Rocket Remnants
companions.role: Their balloon takes out the Carrier Beat in the finale.
postcards: A bottle cap arrives with a drawing of a cat in a balloon. "We are NOT lost," it says. It is signed three times.
A crate of mismatched Poké Balls turns up at the Center. The note says only: "Owed."

companions.name: Wes
companions.role: Stands beside you at the gate in the finale.
postcards: A plain card with one line: "Still out. Still walking."
A postcard of a quiet harbor. On the back, in careful letters: "Somebody I know would have liked it here."

companions.name: Rui
companions.role: Helps your Pokémon in a fight, and lights the Breather in the finale.
postcards: A pressed flower. "They are lighter when someone listens," Rui writes.
A tiny drawing of your lead Pokémon, smiling. She has never met you in a city that has one.

companions.name: Professor Krane
companions.who: a scientist with a card table
companions.role: Carries the Purify Chamber: it counts as one Data ROM at XD001.
postcards: A scrap of graph paper with a diagram and the words "held together with tape".
A short note: "It turns. That's most of science. Waiting near something."

companions.name: Chobin
companions.role: Drives the boat: the Whirlpool Gate is held.
postcards: A sketch of a boat, five Pokémon, and the words "CHOBIN IS DRIVING" in capital letters.
A drawing of your party, better than it has any right to be. He pretends he did not send it.

companions.name: Detective Looker
companions.role: Holds the Cliff Stair, and takes Greevil's number as evidence.
postcards: A card with a badge stamped on it. "Your notes were enough. Thank you."
A very short report, in a very neat hand, that ends: "Be careful."
